tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the package README and manifest to understand Better Auth as a framework-agnostic TypeScript authentication library with a plugin ecosystem.

tour.title: Public Entry Point
tour.description: The package entry re-exports the public API. From here, consumers create an auth instance and import client helpers.

tour.title: Auth Factory Core
tour.description: The auth builders (base, full, minimal) wire context, plugins, adapters, and API routes into a configured Better Auth instance.

tour.title: API Routes & Dispatch
tour.description: Incoming requests are dispatched to auth endpoints for sign-in, sign-up, session, account, password, and OAuth callback flows, with middleware and rate limiting.

tour.title: Runtime Context, Cookies & Crypto
tour.description: Request-scoped context, secure cookies, and cryptographic helpers underpin session creation, token handling, and CSRF/origin protection.

tour.title: Database Layer & Adapters
tour.description: The DB helpers define the auth schema; adapters connect Better Auth to Drizzle, Kysely, Prisma, MongoDB, or in-memory stores.

tour.title: Client SDK & Framework Bindings
tour.description: The client SDK talks to the auth API; React, Vue, Svelte, and Solid bindings expose session state to UI frameworks, with additional app integrations.

tour.title: Social OAuth Providers
tour.description: Built-in social provider definitions configure authorization URLs, scopes, and token exchange for third-party sign-in.

tour.title: Plugin Ecosystem
tour.description: Plugins extend Better Auth with optional features—organizations, admin, two-factor, JWT, magic link, OIDC, captcha, anonymous auth, and more—each adding schema, routes, and client methods.

tour.title: Build & Test Tooling
tour.description: tsdown builds the published package; Vitest configs drive unit and adapter test suites for the library.
